name: Lemon Garlic Roast Chicken
description: A one-tray roast: the lemon halves steam the bird from inside while the potatoes catch the fat.

ingredients.item: salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Toss the potatoes with the oil and garlic in a roasting tin and season well.
Put the lemon halves inside the chicken, sit it on the potatoes, and season the skin.
Roast for 80 minutes, basting once, until the juices run clear.
